info.title: DMS Primary product catalogue
info.description: Read-only, signed-in distributor catalogue. Schemes match explicit Product__c or active Scheme_Product__c links; free-product references and names never imply eligibility. Apex remains authoritative for order pricing and approval.

get.summary: Load products with selectable Primary schemes and informational linked offers

200.description: Current Salesforce catalogue. No pagination token: the Salesforce transport follows query pages. Existing product and barcode fields remain unchanged. linkedSchemes never grants permission to submit an ineligible scheme.

schemes.description: Existing selectable candidates: active Primary channel, matching region, no outlet-type restriction, within Salesforce TODAY date bounds. Quantity and configuration still require validation.

linkedSchemes.description: All explicitly linked offers, including inactive, legacy, Secondary and out-of-date records, for display. An empty array means no direct or active junction link exists.

401.description: A current distributor session is required.

403.description: Distributor access is no longer active.

502.description: Salesforce read failed. No order or discount was changed.
